cohort: The study included four patients with gestational breast cancer undergoing treatment at RSUD dr. Soetomo Surabaya during the period from January 2022 to December 2024.
finding: All four gestational breast cancer patients were over 35 years of age, and all their babies were born with low birth weight and were premature.
mod_finding: Three (75%) patients delivered by caesarean section, and one (25%) underwent laparotomy for fetal evacuation.
